get.description: Fetch basic information about committees and filers. Use parameters to filter for particular characteristics.
Schedule B disbursements aggregated by recipient committee ID, if applicable. To avoid double counting, memoed items are not included.

Key financial data reported periodically by committees as they are reported. This feed includes summary information from the the House F3 reports, the presidential F3p reports and the PAC and party F3x reports. Generally, committees file reports on a quarterly or monthly basis, but some must also submit a report 12 days before primary elections.
